impact: A 5% 10-year raises the discount rate on long-duration growth names (NBIS, PLTR, BE) and keeps pressure on the AI trade into CoreWeave and Nvidia earnings; banks like C benefit from a steeper rate backdrop.
summary: The 10-year Treasury yield climbed about 14bp to roughly 5.00% after hot CPI and Governor Waller's comments. Futures now fully price a 25bp December hike with about 12.5% odds of 50bp. Dallas Fed's Logan said the Fed needs at least two more 25bp hikes and St. Louis Fed's Musalem said more firming is needed soon.
title: 10-year yield back at 5% as Fed hawks line up behind a December hike
